text:
Joanne B: Quick sync thread for 2.20.0 internal announce and pin matrix. aiming to post internal blast at 18:00 PT. need final checks on regional pinning language + rollback cadence.
Marcus L: pasted draft PR link and will add artifact SHAs + rbinctl examples. also proposing a staggered region rollout: NA -> EU -> APAC, 10m pause between regions.
Docs QA: PR: https://phab/repo/PR-5102 (internal announce + regional runbook). trimmed customer-facing bullets to one-liner per audience.
deploy-bot: preflight: staging smoke OK, snapshot snap-2026-03-23-1744 created. scheduled announce queued.
oncall: i'll be on standby 17:45-19:30. please include explicit kill-switch and who is authorized.
Joanne B: for private customers we'll send advisory emails; Hosted/Dedicated get pinned to 2.20.0. include model hashes in the note.
Marcus L: inserted commands in PR:
```
# pin artifacts (example)
rbinctl pin --env=prod --region=us --model=rdw-core --hash=a1b2c3d4
rbinctl pin --env=prod --region=eu --model=rdw-core --hash=a1b2c3d4
# regional kill-switch (oncall only)
rbinctl traffic --env=prod --region=us --set-canary=0
rbinctl traffic --env=prod --region=eu --set-canary=0
```
Joanne B: rollback criteria (short): metric delta method -> if ANY of: 5m error rate >=2% OR P95 token latency increase >=35% OR regression test failures in smoke suite >=2 => immediately reduce that region's canary to 0% and notify #eng-oncall; wait 3 minutes after zero to observe stabilization; if issue persists OR two regions hit thresholds within 15m escalate to full rollback and SEV. detailed flow in runbook.
Docs QA: added grafana links and a short checklist for support to reference: token_latency.p95, inference.errors/5m, model_memory, regional_qps.
oncall: recommend adding an "emergency partial rollback" step: drop region to 0% then re-deploy with previous model variant in the same region if stabilization not seen in 5m. I'll be ready to trigger.
Marcus L: canary plan: per-region 5% for 10m -> 25% for 10m -> full in that region. global ramp happens only after all regions green. include explicit note about the stagger window and an ops pause command.
Joanne B: timeline: 16:00 final copy to ops, 16:30 model hashes locked, 17:30 oncall confirmed, 18:00 deploy window. ops needs the final one-liner by 16:45 for deploybot.
Marcus L: final copy pushed to PR and pasted below.
```
Internal announce: Releasing 2.20.0 at 18:00 PT. Highlights: batching kernels for tail latency reduction, model pin UI, regional pinning support, and console polish. Rollout: staggered by region (NA -> EU -> APAC), canary per region: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 10m -> full. Rollback: reduce region canary to 0% on ANY of: 5m error rate >=2% OR P95 latency +35% OR >=2 failed smoke tests; wait 3m after zero to validate. If issues persist or two regions fail within 15m, escalate to full rollback and SEV. Owners: Joanne B (PM), Marcus L (Release Eng), Oncall (standby). Model hashes, regional pin commands, and full runbook: see PR #5102. Private customers will receive advisories; Dedicated and Hosted will be pinned.
```
oncall: standing by 17:45-19:30. have kill-switch and emergency rollback instructions ready.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window 18:00-19:00 PT. will post internal announce at 18:05 to #eng. quiet-mode set to #eng-oncall.
Joanne B: final checklist: (1) ops receives final copy by 16:00, (2) hashes locked by 16:30, (3) oncall standby confirmed by 17:30, (4) deploybot scheduled (done). i'll post internal blast at 18:05 with the one-liner. thanks team :rocket:
